var_current_boss_teaser: The first successful MAVEN, if you don’t know what a ‘MAVEN’ is, it is an abbreviation for Macroscopic Atomic Valence Experimental Nuclei, didn't you do your research I see? Old Hertz over here or Unit 00Hz-I is a living frequency, specifically 440Hz.

list_boss_teasers: The first successful MAVEN, if you don’t know what a ‘MAVEN’ is, it is an abbreviation for Macroscopic Atomic Valence Experimental Nuclei, didn't you do your research I see? Old Hertz over here or Unit 00Hz-I is a living frequency, specifically 440Hz.

Second MAVEN, based on the element of hydrogen this MAVEN really ticks people off.. Like when Proton-Farmers come in and y’know try to collect hydrogen from the thing it just kinda likes to mess around with them. Using the official name now uh.. 1H-II is a hard one to deal with.

An easy job for Proton-Farmers, hard job for someone like you. Why? 6C-III has a whole bunch of weird little debris that likes to ricochet your bullets off. Proton-Farmers just come in and get elements, no weapons by the way.

Did you know the name was a play on the open-source javascript, CesiumJS, neat huh? Anyway this one, *really* territorial, hates anyone who comes in and loves eating everything. 55Cs-IV does only ‘like’ one person though.
Sovereign, used in two names already, it’s disappointing. 73Ta-V is a smart MAVEN though, they take it slow and actually has hard attacks. Don’t worry you’ll beat it.

10Ne-VI is the main mascot of the project, TRNP. Do you know what TRNP means? No? Someone didn’t do their research, it means The Resourceful Nuclei Project. Also Lord Luminosity is very stubborn. Be careful, don’t look at it straight ahead, it'll hurt your eyes.

So umm, this one is complicated. 14Si-VII is a binary system between two entities, imagine it like a left brain and a right brain. Also you may feel like little zaps in your ADS flight-deck, do you even know what ADS means? Adaptive Discarding Ship. Anyway yeah if you feel little zaps don’t worry.

66Dy-VIII is very big. Caesar Dy is a good name, no? It is living dysprosium, we thought it sounded like dystopium and we thought of the Roman Empire, Caesar, see where we’re getting at here? Also be careful, this one is also very stubborn.

83Bi-IX is one of the most smart MAVENs recorded, but don’t get it wrong, it's like as smart as a pigeon. Also we think it may want to let you kill it? I mean wouldn’t you be in constant pain if you were living bismuth? If you don’t know what bismuth is, google it.
17Cl-X is pretty big and pretty bland. I don’t have much to say about it, personally I don’t like it, it’s kinda scary.

Alarmist-Am, oh boy do I have to say stuff about this one. It is very annoying when you get in it’s containment unit, it keeps making smoke-alarm type noises when you pass by too close. You can hear it beeping whenever you like having your lunch-break right outside of it’s cell, I mean why would you ever want to do that? I don’t know, but 95Am-XI is kinda just farmed to be used in smoke alarms.

Cool name, the ‘slabhraid’ part is actually like Scottish for chain or something. Because this MAVEN is like living manganese, used in chainsaws, it’s I forgot what I was gonna say. Very cool though, 25Mn-XII is like a less annoying bigger brother of 95Am-XI.

Another cool name in my opinion. 92U-XIII has a cool name but in turn it does not look good, but how is CDI supposed to control the looks of MAVENs? I mean they didn’t mean for them to look like this.
The final containment failure. A colossal despair-drenched core wrapped in glitching white filaments, orange geometry, and a smaller Ytterbium-born predator waiting inside it.
